class.name: DSContext
class.brief_description: Core singleton manager for DirectStorage hardware acceleration and fallback backends in Godot.
class.description: [DSContext] manages the lifecycle of the DirectStorage runtime, memory queues, staging buffers, and software fallback backend. The extension registers it as the [Engine] singleton named [code]"DSContext"[/code]. Use [method initialize_ds] before submitting requests, then call [method flush_batch] after enqueuing requests. The addon autoload normally performs this per-frame flush automatically. Async texture prewarm flow: collect engine texture paths ([code].png/.jpg/.webp[/code], never [code].dstex[/code]) with [code]DSPreloader.collect_scene_textures()[/code], enqueue them with [method prewarm_async] (or [code]DSTextureCache.prewarm_async()[/code]) and track the returned tag via the [code]DSRuntime[/code] autoload's [code]track_prewarm(tag)[/code] so per-tag progress signals emit. The batch manager drains the stream queue each frame with [method flush_stream_async], then bind the scene with [code]ResourceLoader.load(level.tscn, "PackedScene", CACHE_MODE_REUSE)[/code]: [constant CACHE_MODE_REUSE] is required so the scene binds the prewarmed textures without reading the disk again. Keep the loading screen visible across [code]instantiate()[/code] + [code]add_child()[/code] + one drawn frame so shader compilation finishes before gameplay is revealed.

method.name: cancel_requests_with_tag
method.description: Cancels all enqueued read requests whose cancellation tag matches [param tag].

method.name: cancel_prewarm
method.description: Marks the prewarm for [param tag] as cancelled (queued requests fail with a "cancelled" message) so [method is_prewarm_complete] returns [code]true[/code].

method.name: collect_completed_results
method.description: Polls and processes completed results from asynchronous batch submissions, updating request statuses and emitting [signal batch_completed] or [signal batch_failed].

method.name: count_stream_terminal_failure
method.description: Records a permanent/terminal failure for one item under prewarm batch [param tag], incrementing the completed progress count so [method is_prewarm_complete] can finish without stalling.

method.name: create_destination_texture
method.description: Creates a RenderingDevice destination texture resource with [param format] and optional [param view] suitable for DirectStorage direct-to-GPU copy operations. Returns the [RID] of the created texture.

method.name: enqueue_request
method.description: Enqueues a configured [DSRequest] into the active I/O queue. The request is not submitted until [method flush_batch] or [method flush_batch_async] is called. When targeting GPU textures with GDeflate compression, automatically splits requests larger than the configured staging buffer into per-mip requests. Returns [code]true[/code] if it was accepted; a null request or unavailable backend returns [code]false[/code].

method.name: flush_batch
method.description: Submits all requests currently queued to the DirectStorage runtime or software fallback worker pool synchronously. Request completion is reflected in each request's [member DSRequest.status].

method.name: flush_batch_async
method.description: Submits all requests currently queued to the DirectStorage runtime asynchronously without blocking the calling thread. Returns [constant OK] if the batch was submitted, [constant ERR_UNCONFIGURED] if the context is uninitialized or has no active backend, or [constant ERR_BUSY] if all backend batch slots are occupied. Completion is signaled via [signal batch_completed] or [signal batch_failed].

method.name: flush_stream_async
method.description: Submits queued requests from the async stream (prewarm) queue without blocking the calling thread. Called once per frame by the [code]DSRuntime[/code] autoload. Harvests finished batches first to free backend slots, then submits at most half the queue capacity per call (clamped to 64-256 requests); any remainder stays queued for the next frame. Regular synchronous loads use a separate queue drained by [method flush_batch] / [method flush_batch_async] and are unaffected. Returns [constant OK] on submit (including when the queue is empty), [constant ERR_BUSY] when all backend batch slots are occupied (the queue is kept for retry next frame), or [constant ERR_UNCONFIGURED] when uninitialized.

method.name: get_active_backend_name
method.description: Returns the active backend name. The DirectStorage backend is named [code]"Win32DirectStorage"[/code]; the software backend is named [code]"SoftwareFallback"[/code]. Returns [code]"None"[/code] before initialization.

method.name: get_actual_backend
method.description: Returns the backend name that processed or was assigned to process [param request].

method.name: get_actual_destination_type
method.description: Returns the actual destination type used to process [param request].

method.name: get_async_batches_submitted
method.description: Returns the total number of asynchronous batches submitted via [method flush_batch_async] / [method flush_stream_async] since initialization. Because many textures share one batch, this number is normally far below the texture count. Returns [code]0[/code] before initialization.

method.name: get_auto_tune_for_integrated_gpu
method.description: Returns whether integrated-GPU auto-tune is enabled (see [member auto_tune_for_integrated_gpu]).

method.name: get_auto_tune_for_low_vram_gpu
method.description: Returns whether low-VRAM discrete-GPU staging auto-tune is enabled (see [member auto_tune_for_low_vram_gpu]).

method.name: get_capability_report
method.description: Returns a comprehensive [Dictionary] detailing the active backend, Direct3D 12 device status, GPU decompression support tier, GPU decompression enabled status, queue capacity, staging buffer configuration, and DXGI adapter identity ([code]adapter_name[/code], [code]adapter_vendor[/code], [code]dedicated_vram_mb[/code], [code]shared_system_mb[/code], [code]software_adapter[/code], [code]integrated_gpu_guess[/code]).

method.name: get_runtime_info
method.description: Returns the installed DirectStorage runtime identity and feature probes without any GPU query: [code]version[/code] (e.g. "1.3.2506.2501", or "Unavailable"), [code]version_major[/code], [code]version_minor[/code], [code]version_build[/code], [code]version_revision[/code], [code]loaded[/code] (whether dstorage.dll and dstoragecore.dll are mapped), and a [code]capabilities[/code] dictionary with [code]zstd[/code], [code]zstd_probed[/code], [code]gacl[/code], [code]enqueue_requests[/code], [code]configuration2[/code] and [code]creator_id[/code].

method.name: get_gpu_adapter_info
method.description: Returns identity details for the exact graphics device in use (matched by adapter LUID, so multi-GPU PCs report the right one): [code]available[/code], [code]adapter_name[/code] (e.g. "AMD Radeon(TM) Graphics"), [code]adapter_vendor[/code], [code]vendor_id[/code], [code]device_id[/code], [code]dedicated_vram_mb[/code] (the GPU's own private memory; tiny or zero on integrated graphics), [code]shared_system_mb[/code] (ordinary RAM the GPU may borrow), [code]software_adapter[/code] (true for Microsoft WARP emulation, i.e. no real GPU), and [code]integrated_gpu_guess[/code] (true when dedicated memory is under 1 GiB — the sign of graphics that share system RAM). [code]available[/code] is [code]false[/code] off Windows or without an active D3D12 device.

method.name: get_completion_fence
method.description: Returns the most recent D3D12 completion fence value used for GPU request synchronization.

method.name: get_disable_gpu_decompression
method.description: Returns whether GPU decompression has been disabled.

method.name: get_disable_gpu_decompression_metacommand
method.description: Returns whether the driver's optimized GPU decompression metacommand has been disabled, i.e. the reference implementation is used instead.

method.name: get_drive_info
method.description: Returns drive capability information for [param path], including [code]drive[/code], [code]bus_type[/code], [code]file_system[/code], [code]bypassio_state[/code], [code]media_type[/code] ([code]HDD[/code], [code]SSD[/code], or [code]Unknown[/code]), [code]rotational[/code], [code]rotational_known[/code], [code]seek_penalty[/code], [code]trim[/code], [code]directstorage_supported[/code], and, when applicable, [code]reason[/code]. [code]rotational[/code] is the media signal that selects the DirectStorage I/O mode.

method.name: get_gpu_decompression_support_tier
method.description: Returns the GPU decompression path reported by DirectStorage: [code]0[/code] unsupported (CPU decode only), [code]1[/code] GPU fallback via compute shaders (works, slower), [code]2[/code] GPU-optimized GDeflate path.

method.name: get_gpu_decompression_queue_type
method.description: Returns the Direct3D 12 queue type used by DirectStorage for GPU decompression: [code]"compute"[/code] if decompression executes on a compute queue, [code]"copy"[/code] if executed on a copy queue, or [code]"none"[/code] if unsupported or on fallback.

method.name: is_gpu_decompression_optimized
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if GPU decompression uses an optimized graphics driver path rather than a shader fallback or CPU decode.

method.name: get_in_flight_async_batch_count
method.description: Returns the number of asynchronous batches currently in flight (submitted but not yet collected via [method collect_completed_results]). Returns [code]0[/code] when no batch is running.

method.name: get_init_status
method.description: Returns the initialization status of the DirectStorage context as an [enum DSContext.InitStatus] constant.

method.name: get_pending_request_count
method.description: Returns the number of requests currently enqueued in [DSContext] awaiting synchronous ([method flush_batch]) or asynchronous ([method flush_batch_async]) submission.

method.name: get_prewarm_progress
method.description: Returns prewarm progress for [param tag] as [code]Vector2i(done, total)[/code] for progress-bar display. Unknown tags return [code](0, 0)[/code]. Poll this or await the [code]DSRuntime[/code] autoload's [code]prewarm_finished[/code] signal (tags are tracked opt-in via [code]track_prewarm(tag)[/code]).

method.name: get_queue_capacity
method.description: Returns the maximum number of requests allowed in a queue. The default is [code]512[/code].

method.name: get_request_execution_report
method.description: Returns a telemetry [Dictionary] for [param request], containing [code]actual_destination_type[/code] ([int]), [code]actual_backend[/code] ([String]), [code]was_gpu_decompression_used[/code] ([bool]), and [code]gpu_decompression_pending[/code] ([bool]). Telemetry is finalized upon batch completion.

method.name: get_staging_buffer_size_mb
method.description: Returns the configured staging buffer size in MiB. The default is [code]128[/code].

method.name: get_stream_pending_count
method.description: Returns the number of requests currently waiting in the async stream (prewarm) queue.

method.name: has_pending_results
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if there are pending asynchronous batch results waiting to be collected via [method collect_completed_results].

method.name: has_stream_pending
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the async stream (prewarm) queue holds requests awaiting [method flush_stream_async].

method.name: initialize_ds
method.description: Initializes DirectStorage hardware queues and staging buffers. Returns [code]true[/code] if initialized successfully.

method.name: initialize_ds_for_path
method.description: Initializes DirectStorage targeting the specific volume where [param path] is located. Validates volume bypass eligibility and DirectStorage support before initializing. Accepts file paths, directory paths, and Godot virtual paths ([code]res://[/code], [code]user://[/code]). Rotational NTFS volumes select buffered file I/O ([code]ForceFileBuffering[/code], BypassIO disabled) for the process; flash volumes keep the default unbuffered path. If the specified path is on an unsupported drive, falls back to default [code]res://[/code] initialization or software fallback. Returns [constant @GlobalScope.OK] on success, or [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND] if the specified path does not exist.

method.name: is_batch_complete
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the current asynchronous batch has completed execution on the storage and GPU queues.

method.name: is_current_drive_supported
method.description: Returns whether the drive containing the running executable supports DirectStorage.

method.name: is_d3d12_backend
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when DirectStorage is supported and Godot is using a valid Direct3D 12 logical device.

method.name: is_gpu_decompression_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if hardware GPU decompression is supported by the GPU adapter, Direct3D 12 device, and DirectStorage runtime.

method.name: is_gpu_decompression_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if GPU decompression is currently enabled and available (i.e. supported and not disabled via [member disable_gpu_decompression]).

method.name: is_integrated_gpu
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the PC's graphics look like an integrated GPU — one that shares system RAM (typical for laptops, handhelds, and mini-PCs) instead of having its own dedicated VRAM. Detected via Windows Direct3D 12 Unified Memory Architecture (UMA) hardware query, with fallback heuristic checking for under 1 GiB of dedicated video memory. Returns [code]false[/code] when unknown, off Windows, or without an active D3D12 device. See [member auto_tune_for_integrated_gpu].

method.name: is_uma
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the active Direct3D 12 adapter reports Unified Memory Architecture (UMA == TRUE via [code]D3D12_FEATURE_ARCHITECTURE1[/code]), indicating CPU and GPU share the same physical system RAM bus.

method.name: is_initialized
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [DSContext] has been initialized.

method.name: is_path_supported
method.description: Returns whether the drive containing [param path] supports DirectStorage. This does not initialize the runtime.

method.name: is_prewarm_complete
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when every request for [param tag] has finished (completed, failed, or cancelled) and none remain queued. Unknown tags report [code]true[/code] (nothing pending).

method.name: is_supported
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the native Windows DirectStorage backend is available. A software fallback can still initialize on unsupported platforms, but this method remains [code]false[/code].

method.name: is_tag_cancelled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if prewarm or cancellation tag [param tag] has been marked as cancelled.

method.name: prewarm_async
method.description: Issues a fresh stream tag and registers its expected request total for progress queries. Accepts engine texture paths ([code].png/.jpg/.webp[/code]); file remapping is resolved internally. Non-blocking: call [code]track_prewarm(tag)[/code] on the [code]DSRuntime[/code] autoload for per-tag progress signals, then bind with [code]CACHE_MODE_REUSE[/code] once [method is_prewarm_complete] holds.

method.name: set_auto_tune_for_integrated_gpu
method.description: Enables or disables integrated-GPU auto-tune (see [member auto_tune_for_integrated_gpu]). When enabled and the PC's graphics share system RAM instead of having dedicated VRAM, the effective staging buffer and queue capacity are lowered to 64 MiB / 256 at initialization. Never raises values; set [code]false[/code] to use your configured values exactly.

method.name: set_auto_tune_for_low_vram_gpu
method.description: Enables or disables low-VRAM discrete-GPU staging auto-tune (see [member auto_tune_for_low_vram_gpu]). When enabled, a discrete adapter's effective staging buffer is capped by dedicated VRAM (32 MiB under 2 GiB, 64 MiB under 8 GiB; 8 GiB and above are untouched). Never raises values and never changes the queue; set [code]false[/code] to use your configured value exactly.

method.name: set_disable_gpu_decompression
method.description: Enables or disables GPU decompression for subsequent initialization and requests.

method.name: set_disable_gpu_decompression_metacommand
method.description: Keeps GPU decompression enabled but forces the reference implementation instead of the driver's optimized metacommand. Affects the next initialization, so it can be used to compare both GPU paths on the same machine.

method.name: set_prewarm_total
method.description: Sets or overrides the total expected item count for async prewarm batch [param tag]. Used by the streaming manager when expanding discovery dependencies dynamically.

method.name: set_queue_capacity
method.description: Sets the maximum queue capacity used by the backend.

method.name: set_staging_buffer_size_mb
method.description: Sets the staging buffer size in MiB. A value less than or equal to zero restores the default of [code]128[/code] MiB.

method.name: shutdown_ds
method.description: Shuts down DirectStorage queues, releases COM interfaces, and cleans up active backend resources.

method.name: wait_for_completion
method.description: Blocks execution until the pending GPU completion fence is signaled and RenderingDevice synchronization completes, or until [param timeout_msec] milliseconds elapse. Returns [code]true[/code] if the fence completed successfully.

method.name: was_gpu_decompression_used
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if hardware GPU decompression was verified to have been used for decompressing [param request]. Verified on batch completion.

members.member: Automatically shrinks DirectStorage memory usage on integrated GPUs (laptop/handheld graphics that share system RAM instead of having their own VRAM). When [code]true[/code] and such a GPU is detected, the effective staging buffer and queue capacity are lowered to 64 MiB / 256 at startup, and the log states the before/after values. Only ever lowers, never raises: values you set below the caps pass through untouched, your saved settings are never rewritten, and discrete-GPU PCs are unaffected. Set [code]false[/code] for full manual control.

Caps DirectStorage staging memory on discrete GPUs with little dedicated VRAM. When [code]true[/code], the effective staging buffer is capped at 64 MiB on 2-8 GiB cards and 32 MiB under 2 GiB, and the log states the before/after values. 8 GiB and above are unaffected, the queue is never changed, and a lower configured value passes through untouched. This is independent of [member auto_tune_for_integrated_gpu]. Set [code]false[/code] to use your configured value on every GPU.
If [code]true[/code], forces DirectStorage runtime to perform CPU decompression instead of GPU decompression shaders.

If [code]true[/code], DirectStorage uses the reference GPU decompression implementation instead of the driver's optimized metacommand. Independent of [member disable_gpu_decompression]: leave that [code]false[/code] to compare both GPU paths, and set this when the optimized path misbehaves or measures slower.
The maximum request capacity for the DirectStorage queue. The default is [code]512[/code].
The size in megabytes of each staging buffer allocated by DirectStorage.

signal.name: batch_completed
signal.description: Emitted when an asynchronous batch submission finishes executing on the storage and GPU queues.

signal.name: batch_failed
signal.description: Emitted when an asynchronous batch submission fails.

constants.constant: The DirectStorage context has not been initialized.
DirectStorage runtime initialized successfully with the native Win32 D3D12 backend.
DirectStorage native runtime was unavailable; initialized with the CPU software fallback backend.
Context initialization failed completely (neither DirectStorage nor software fallback could start).
